title: Resolution-free neural surrogates for geometric parameterization and mapping with spatially varying fields
abstract: arXiv:2605.28551v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Many imaging problems require computing spatial transformations induced by spatially varying intensity, feature, or density fields. Canonical examples include distortion correction, deformable image registration, atlas-based segmentation, and deformation-driven image analysis. These tasks can be formulated as geometric mapping problems in which the transformation is constrained to preserve local structure, control boundary behavior, or regulate angular distortion. Such formulations typically lead to variational models, diffusion processes, or elliptic partial differential equations. However, repeatedly solving high-resolution systems becomes computationally expensive when the underlying parameter fields vary across instances. In this work, we propose a resolution-free neural surrogate for geometric parameterization and mapping problems. Given a spatially varying parameter field $p:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^m$ and grid nodes $\{x_i\}_

translated_title: 面向空间变化场的几何参数化与映射的无分辨率神经代理模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.28551v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：许多成像问题需要计算由空间变化的强度场、特征场或密度场所诱导的空间变换。典型例子包括畸变校正、可变形图像配准、基于图谱的分割以及变形驱动的图像分析。这些任务可以被表述为几何映射问题，其中变换需满足保持局部结构、控制边界行为或调节角度畸变等约束。此类表述通常对应变分模型、扩散过程或椭圆型偏微分方程。然而，当底层参数场在不同实例之间变化时，反复求解高分辨率系统的计算代价会变得非常高。在本工作中，我们提出了一种面向几何参数化与映射问题的无分辨率神经代理模型。给定一个空间变化的参数场 $p:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^m$ 和网格节点 $\{x_i\}_...
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无分辨率的神经代理模型，能够以较低计算成本求解由空间变化参数场驱动的几何参数化与映射问题（如畸变校正、可变形图像配准等），避免了反复求解高分辨率偏微分方程系统的昂贵开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a resolution-free neural surrogate that efficiently solves geometric parameterization and mapping problems driven by spatially varying parameter fields, eliminating the costly repeated solution of high-resolution systems.
